name: cerefox-local-runtime
description: The Cerefox Local image's embedder runtime. Pinned exactly and installed from the committed bun.lock (#300): the image used to resolve ^ ranges on every build, so two builds of one tag could embed differently. The transformers and onnxruntime-node versions the repo's own lockfile resolves (what an npm install of @cerefox/memory gets at release time); onnxruntime-node matches the version transformers pins, so there is one copy, the one that runs.
